title: Gmail Link Unshortener Policy
description: Configuration policy for the Gmail Link Unshortener & Tracker Blocker Chrome extension.

managedAllowlist.title: Managed Allowlist
managedAllowlist.description: List of trusted domains that bypass all scanning, unshortening, and threat checks.

managedBlocklist.title: Managed Blocklist
managedBlocklist.description: Custom tracking, advertising, or redirect domains to forcibly unshorten, trace, and clean.

managedRemoveTrackingPixels.title: Remove Tracking Pixels Completely
managedRemoveTrackingPixels.description: If true, completely removes tracking pixel elements from the email DOM instead of replacing them with a visual placeholder icon.
